name: forest-defender-ii
description: Forest Defender: Mushroom Mayhem — Three.js re-implementation

scripts.dev: bun scripts/package-models.js src && bun scripts/package-icons.js && bun ./index.html
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun scripts/package-models.js src && bun scripts/package-icons.js && bun build ./src/main.js --outdir dist --minify --asset-naming=[name].[ext] && sed 's|src="./src/main.js"|src="./main.js"|' index.html > dist/index.html && rm -f src/models.bundle src/icons.bundle
